tm_dig.name: TM28 挖洞
tm_dig.source_description: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.

fr_tm05.name: TM05 吼叫
fr_tm05.description: 迫使对手换下；野战可能结束。
fr_tm05.source_description: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.

fr_tm15.name: TM15 破坏光线
fr_tm15.description: 强力攻击；原作下一回合硬直。
fr_tm15.source_description: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.

fr_tm28.name: TM28 挖洞
fr_tm28.source_description: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.

fr_tm31.name: TM31 劈瓦
fr_tm31.source_description: An attack that also breaks any barrier like LIGHT SCREEN and REFLECT.

fr_tm43.name: TM43 秘密之力
fr_tm43.description: 攻击并可能产生地形附加效果。
fr_tm43.source_description: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.

fr_tm45.name: TM45 迷人
fr_tm45.source_description: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.

fr_tm16.name: TM16 光墙
fr_tm16.description: 暂时减轻特殊攻击伤害。
fr_tm16.source_description: A wall of light cuts damage from SP. ATK attacks for five turns.

fr_tm20.name: TM20 神秘守护
fr_tm20.source_description: It protects the user's party from all status problems for five turns.

fr_tm33.name: TM33 反射壁
fr_tm33.description: 暂时减轻物理攻击伤害。
fr_tm33.source_description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

fr_tm01.name: TM01 真气拳
fr_tm01.description: 蓄力后出拳，期间受攻击会失败。
fr_tm01.source_description: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.

fr_tm02.name: TM02 龙爪
fr_tm02.source_description: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.

fr_tm03.name: TM03 水之波动
fr_tm03.description: 攻击并可能使对手混乱。
fr_tm03.source_description: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

fr_tm04.name: TM04 冥想
fr_tm04.description: 提高自己的特攻和特防。
fr_tm04.source_description: The user focuses its mind to raise the SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.

fr_tm06.name: TM06 剧毒
fr_tm06.description: 使对手陷入逐回合加重的剧毒。
fr_tm06.source_description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

fr_tm07.name: TM07 冰雹
fr_tm07.source_description: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all POKéMON except the ICE-type.

fr_tm08.name: TM08 健美
fr_tm08.description: 提高自己的攻击和防御。
fr_tm08.source_description: The user bulks up its body to boost both its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.

fr_tm09.name: TM09 种子机关枪
fr_tm09.source_description: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.

fr_tm10.name: TM10 觉醒力量
fr_tm10.description: 属性和威力取决于个体。
fr_tm10.source_description: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.

fr_tm11.name: TM11 大晴天
fr_tm11.source_description: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up FIRE-type moves.

fr_tm12.name: TM12 挑衅
fr_tm12.description: 限制对手使用变化招式。
fr_tm12.source_description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.

fr_tm13.name: TM13 冰冻光束
fr_tm13.source_description: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may freeze the foe solid.

fr_tm17.name: TM17 守住
fr_tm17.description: 尝试阻挡本回合的攻击。
fr_tm17.source_description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

fr_tm18.name: TM18 求雨
fr_tm18.source_description: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up WATER- type moves.

fr_tm19.name: TM19 终极吸取
fr_tm19.description: 攻击并回复造成伤害的一半。
fr_tm19.source_description: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

fr_tm21.name: TM21 迁怒
fr_tm21.source_description: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its TRAINER.

fr_tm23.name: TM23 铁尾
fr_tm23.description: 攻击并可能降低对手防御。
fr_tm23.source_description: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe's DEFENSE stat.

fr_tm24.name: TM24 十万伏特
fr_tm24.source_description: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

fr_tm25.name: TM25 打雷
fr_tm25.description: 强力雷击，可能麻痹对手。
fr_tm25.source_description: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

fr_tm27.name: TM27 报恩
fr_tm27.source_description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its TRAINER.

fr_tm29.name: TM29 精神强念
fr_tm29.description: 攻击并可能降低对手特防。
fr_tm29.source_description: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe's SP. DEF stat.

fr_tm30.name: TM30 暗影球
fr_tm30.description: 攻击并可能降低对手特防。
fr_tm30.source_description: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe's SP. DEF.

fr_tm34.name: TM34 电击波
fr_tm34.description: 无视一般命中和闪避变化的电击。
fr_tm34.source_description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. It can't be evaded.

fr_tm35.name: TM35 喷射火焰
fr_tm35.source_description: The foe is scorched with intense flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

fr_tm36.name: TM36 污泥炸弹
fr_tm36.description: 攻击并可能使对手中毒。
fr_tm36.source_description: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.

fr_tm37.name: TM37 沙暴
fr_tm37.source_description: A 5-turn sandstorm that damages all types except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.

fr_tm38.name: TM38 大字爆炎
fr_tm38.description: 强力火焰攻击，可能灼伤对手。
fr_tm38.source_description: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.

fr_tm39.name: TM39 岩石封锁
fr_tm39.source_description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe's SPEED if it hits.

fr_tm40.name: TM40 燕返
fr_tm40.description: 无视一般命中和闪避变化的攻击。
fr_tm40.source_description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can't be evaded.

fr_tm41.name: TM41 无理取闹
fr_tm41.description: 不能连续使用同一招式。
fr_tm41.source_description: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.

fr_tm42.name: TM42 硬撑
fr_tm42.source_description: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

fr_tm44.name: TM44 睡觉
fr_tm44.source_description: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.

fr_tm46.name: TM46 小偷
fr_tm46.source_description: An attack that may take the foe's held item if the user isn't holding one.

fr_tm47.name: TM47 钢翼
fr_tm47.description: 攻击并可能提高自己的防御。
fr_tm47.source_description: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's DEFENSE.

fr_tm48.name: TM48 特性互换
fr_tm48.limitation: 仅交换当前单打已接入的特性效果；未扩建全部特性。
fr_tm48.source_description: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.

fr_tm49.name: TM49 抢夺
fr_tm49.description: 抢先夺用对手的部分变化招式。
fr_tm49.source_description: Steals the effects of the foe's healing or status- changing move.

fr_tm50.name: TM50 过热
fr_tm50.description: 强力攻击后大幅降低自己特攻。
fr_tm50.source_description: An intense attack that also sharply reduces the user's SP. ATK stat.
